name: raksul-catalog
description: Render the Stockroom database storefront through its loopback Go backend.

interface.shortDescription: Shop the local Stockroom database mock.
interface.longDescription: An embedded MCP App using the Stockroom Go API as its only access to PostgreSQL and MinIO, with demo users, sized products, persisted carts, quotes, and explicit mock-order confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Render the embedded RAKSUL Stockroom storefront here. Do not open any supplier website.
Use the Stockroom mini-app to select a demo user and browse sized products.
Build a Stockroom cart, show the mock quote, then ask me before placing or rejecting the order.
